blurb: Hunter's Edge offers riding lessons for adults and children ages 6 and up, focusing on Hunters, Jumpers, and Equitation disciplines. They provide lesson horses and tack for all levels, emphasizing safety and skill development. Boarding and training services include full care, specialized therapies, and a competitive showing program.
extraNote: Release form must be signed before first lesson · Viewing by appointment only at 6400 Dorrell, Las Vegas NV 89131
